segments.name: Cell Replacement Therapies
segments.description: Clinical-stage biotechnology company developing allogeneic cell replacement therapies for serious medical conditions including dry-AMD, spinal cord injury, hearing loss, and diabetes.
segments.evidence: We are a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing cell replacement therapies to treat serious medical conditions.
